doc.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21

chapter: Armstrong, the boats and the downtown halls
title: Louis Armstrong in 1915 at Libby and Padilla's, pianos in the bands
summary: Martin says that in 1915 Louis played in short pants in a three-piece group at Libby and Padilla's with a clarinetist called Freddie. They discuss piano being in honky-tonks but not in hall bands, and Bunk's story of 'Mustache', the Italian who ran the place.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: Right? He played? He hadn't went then. No, he played on the board. He played on the board. You see? Yeah. Lewis, in 15, Lewis was playing Libby and Padilla. Oh, yes, I remember that.
In Short Pants. Him and Freddie.

The three piece there. I remember. Freddie who? Brian Freddie. Oh, Brian Freddie. Yeah, he blew, he blew his hop and hop. Oh, yes, yeah. I met him, yes. He played clarinet a little too, didn't he? Yeah, with Lewis. In that Libby and Padilla.
